mapper.select: SELECT evidence.id AS evidence_id, evidence.original_filename, evidence.file_path, evidence.content_type FROM email_draft_attachments AS attachment JOIN email_drafts AS draft ON draft.id = attachment.email_draft_id JOIN case_evidences AS evidence ON evidence.id = attachment.evidence_id AND evidence.case_id = draft.case_id WHERE attachment.email_draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY attachment.id
